Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1614530. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as inner join, join assays on assay_id. Filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614530' and activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.standard_value is not null. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Do not deduplicate.
